question: In a Heckscher-Ohlin model, what determines the comparative advantage of a country?
options: The technology used
The relative abundance of factors of production.
The size of the market
The exchange rate

question: In a Ricardo-Viner model, what is the effect of a change in the world price of a commodity on the domestic price of that commodity?
options: The domestic price of the commodity increases
The domestic price of the commodity decreases
The domestic price of the commodity increases or decreases
The domestic price of the commodity remains unchanged.

question: What is the effect of an increase in the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) on the multiplier?
options: It has no effect on the multiplier
It decreases the multiplier
It increases the multiplier.
It remains constant

question: What is the primary effect of a tax on capital in a competitive capital market?
options: A decrease in the capital stock.
An increase in the capital stock
A decrease in the wage rate
No change in the capital stock

question: What is the primary effect of a decrease in the level of government debt on the interest rate in the IS-LM model?
options: A decrease in the interest rate.
No change in the interest rate
A decrease in the money supply
An increase in the interest rate

question: A country's monetary policy is aimed at reducing unemployment. What is the effect on the interest rate?
options: The interest rate will remain unchanged
The interest rate will decrease but at a slower rate
The interest rate will decrease
The interest rate will increase
